onset.Description: Start of the epoch within the concatenated epoched recording

trial_type.Description: Every row is one epoch (trial segment) of the source FieldTrip data

sample.Description: First sample of the epoch (0-based) in the BrainVision file

epoch_index.Description: 1-based index of the trial in the source data.trial cell array

time_zero_sample.Description: Sample (0-based) at which the source trial time axis equals 0 s (source time axis starts at -1.5 s)

trialinfo_1.Description: Column 1 of the source FieldTrip data.trialinfo matrix, copied verbatim. The OSF release and the paper do not document the trialinfo columns; values are kept for users of the authors' analysis code.
